title: One id of the registry's live layer (<home>/state/registry-live/entries/<kind>/<path of the id>)
description: What processes on this machine have noted about one id and have not committed to a repository: every claim, with who made it, when and for which task. Written by `gatekit registry note` under the file's lock; read by `registry show`, `at`, `clashes` and `commit`. The provenance stays here: `registry commit` leaves it behind.

entry.description: The entry as its kind's schema has it (registry/function, type or global), without `schema`.

who.description: The agent or person that noted it.

committed.description: When `registry commit` wrote it into a checkout's registry.
